These updated vaccines are designed to provide better protection against circulating COVID-19 variants. Specifically, the following vaccines have been authorized: Moderna COVID-19 Vaccine (2024-2025 Formula) for individuals 6 months through 11 years of age, Novavax COVID-19 Vaccine, Adjuvanted (2024-2025 Formula) for individuals 12 years of age and older, and Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 Vaccine (2024-2025 Formula) for individuals 6 months through 11 years of age. Additionally, the FDA has approved updated labeling for mRNA COVID-19 vaccines, including Comirnaty (Pfizer-BioNTech) and Spikevax (Moderna), to include new safety information about the risks of myocarditis and pericarditis following vaccination.

Question: fda approved covid-19 vaccines

Answer: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved and authorized for emergency use updated COVID-19 vaccines for the 2024-2025 formula. These updated vaccines are designed to provide better protection against circulating COVID-19 variants. Specifically, the following vaccines have been authorized: Moderna COVID-19 Vaccine (2024-2025 Formula) for individuals 6 months through 11 years of age, Novavax COVID-19 Vaccine, Adjuvanted (2024-2025 Formula) for individuals 12 years of age and older, and Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 Vaccine (2024-2025 Formula) for individuals 6 months through 11 years of age.
Additionally, the FDA has approved updated labeling for mRNA COVID-19 vaccines, including Comirnaty (Pfizer-BioNTech) and Spikevax (Moderna), to include new safety information about the risks of myocarditis and pericarditis following vaccination.
